# Gold Class Head Spa Chermside

> Luxury head spa at Westfield Chermside, Brisbane (north side). Private
> treatment rooms, scalp care and deep relaxation, finished with a blow dry.

## Treatments and prices
- Head Spa Essential, 30 minutes, $119 AUD: face cleanse, deep-cleansing hair
  shampoo, moisturising conditioner and scalp massage, neck and shoulder massage, waterfall
  halo, gentle hair blow-dry.
- Head Spa Experience, 60 minutes, $199 AUD: herbal and Epsom salt foot bath,
  dry relaxation head massage, steam therapy, radiance facial, tailored shampoo,
  relaxing scalp massage, nourishing conditioner, waterfall halo, neck, shoulder
  and arm massage, gentle 57°C ionic hair dry.
- Head Spa Premium, 90 minutes, $299 AUD: everything in the Experience plus
  extended massage time, nourishing face mask, intensive hair mask treatment
  and scalp exfoliation.
- An additional $20 applies for hair longer than shoulder length.
- Gift cards (valid at Chermside only): https://app.squareup.com/gift/MLMH2T1G71P4T/order

## Location
Shop 403, Level 1, Westfield Chermside, 395 Hamilton Road, Chermside QLD 4032,
Australia. Near Best&Less.

## Hours
- Monday to Wednesday: 9:00am to 5:30pm
- Thursday: 9:00am to 9:00pm
- Friday: 9:00am to 5:30pm
- Saturday: 9:00am to 5:00pm
- Sunday: 10:00am to 4:00pm

## Parking and what to expect
- Parking: the Lime car park at Westfield Chermside is the easiest option.
- Arrive 10 minutes before your appointment.
- Your hair is washed and dried before you leave.
- Gift cards are valid at Gold Class Head Spa Chermside for three years from the date of purchase.
